IMPORTANT: Place your Hikayat Al Sahra logo image here as "logo.png"
The file should be saved at: public/logo.png

Steps:
1. Right-click the logo image in the chat
2. Save it as "logo.png"  
3. Copy it into this "public" folder
4. The website will automatically show it in the navbar

The logo will appear in the top-left of the navigation bar.
